info.name: HUD User CHAS Fair Market Rents API
Get Fair Market Rents by State

params.name: state
params.description: Two-letter state abbreviation (e.g., AL, CA, TX)

params.name: year
params.description: Fiscal year for FMR data (e.g., 2024). Defaults to the most recent year.

items.docs: Returns Fair Market Rent data for all counties and metropolitan areas within the specified state. FMRs cover efficiency through four-bedroom unit sizes.

info.name: Get Fair Market Rents by Entity

params.name: entityid
params.description: HUD geographic entity identifier. For counties, use the 5-digit FIPS code. For metropolitan areas, use the CBSA code.

items.docs: Returns Fair Market Rent data for a specific geographic entity identified by its HUD entity ID (county FIPS code or CBSA code).
